description: This file defines a React functional component named APIReferenceView that renders an API documentation page with code examples for different SDKs (OpenAI Python SDK, LlamaIndex, Langchain). It includes UI layout, tabs for code snippets, and dynamic base URL configuration based on proxy settings.

methods.name: APIReferenceView
methods.description: React functional component that renders a UI with API code examples and documentation link, configurable via proxySettings props.
